contracts: LEVEL_TABLE at 0x00002C78 contains one per-frame callback pointer at offset 0x2C and one exit callback pointer at offset 0x28 for each of 13 levels.
The frame callbacks are invoked during active level service and the exit callbacks are invoked during level transition setup.
The renamed identities preserve the exact addresses, ranges, descriptions, and legacy aliases for every callback pair.
evidence: per-level callback descriptions and cached decompilations
limitations: The names describe callback phase and level ownership; they do not claim that every callback is reached in every scene or route.
Older findings retain the historical EnterRoutine/ExitRoutine spelling as compatibility aliases.
conclusion: All 26 level-table callback entry points now use phase-accurate semantic names, reducing the remaining generic Routine labels without changing ROM ownership or behavior.
